subject: Chrimbo
author: ichienkai
body:
Many thanks for the christmas wishes etc but when didnt christmas suck?

Sorry for this but for one i dont have any time off work - at all - i freeze my arse off on my motorcycle everyday and risk my life every single second in winter - im skint paying for presents an stuff - Isnt Christmas just for Kids?  Am i being Bah Humbug here or does anyone else think Christmas bites the big one hahahaha LOL 

Nice picture by the way Xan, try navigating through that on a bike...!  Yeah you guessed in my opinion Christmas is commercialized bullsh*t - maybe im tired and need a good nights rest?
